name: Hands-On Electronics: Schematics, Breadboarding & Soldering
summary: Practical bench skills for a beginner: read a schematic, build and measure circuits on a breadboard, and solder a working board.

topics.name: Schematic symbols and how to read a circuit diagram
Identifying components: resistor colour codes, capacitor markings, polarity
Using a multimeter: voltage, current, resistance and continuity
Bench power supplies and batteries, current limiting
The transistor as a switch (driving a relay, motor or lamp)
Building a 555 timer blinker and other classic starter circuits
Reading a datasheet: pinouts, absolute maximum ratings, typical application
Systematic troubleshooting of a circuit that does not work
